notes.title: “When the perfect comes”
notes.intro: Paul says prophecy and tongues will cease “when the perfect comes.”

views.label: The perfect is Christ’s return
views.summary: Most Christians read “the perfect” as the end of the age, so gifts continue until then.

views.label: The perfect is the completed New Testament
views.summary: Some cessationists read it as the completion of Scripture, after which miraculous gifts ended.
views.source: Common teaching in Churches of Christ

notes.common: All agree the chapter’s main point is that love never fails.
